newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $16 billion of bills Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $16 billion of bills Aug 18.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will sell $16 billion of three- and six-month bills on August 18, resulting in a $1.2 billion paydown of outstanding, debt as $17.211 billion of bills are maturing.
The bills, to be sold in equal amounts for each maturity, will be issued on August 21. The three-month bills mature on November 20 and the six-month bills mature on February 19, 1998.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills will be 9127945U4 and for the six-month bills 9127946E9.
